<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Deflecting Pulse](/Feats.aspx?ID=5456) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 70

**Archetype** [Ostilli Host](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=222)

**Prerequisites**
[Ostilli Host Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5451)

</column>

---

Your ostilli can use its stored magic to protect you from other magic, granting you the Turn Aside Ambient Magic action.

 **Turn Aside Ambient Magic** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) Your ostilli glows a faint yellow as it establishes a barrier. Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage. Until the beginning of your next turn, you gain resistance against the chosen damage type equal to half your level.
name: Deflecting Pulse
